summary: Verified data sync from reference site (prazo-payment-sys.emergent.host). All 5 backend assertions match source exactly (cash drawer Runner+GYM, prazo debts Runner+GYM, expenses total). Frontend Prazo tab loads in Gestor dashboard, KPI 'Total a receber' shows R$ 10.615,60 (consolidated = 8727.9 + 1887.7), customer list renders, and filter switching (Todas/Runner/GYM Londres/Todas) produces NO React removeChild / NotFoundError / commitDeletionEffectsOnFiber errors.
critical_code_review_comments: There are two duplicate /api/cash/{store}/drawer endpoints (routers/cash.py:142 and server.py:1879). Both now include the synthetic filter, but having two route definitions for the same URL is risky; the order of router registration determines which one wins. Recommend consolidating into a single endpoint to avoid drift in future fixes.

Server-side aggregation could be added so /api/prazo/debts returns the precomputed total instead of letting the frontend recompute (currently both reference site and this app are consistent, but a server-side total avoids client float drift).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints verified against reference site values: /api/cash/runner/drawer (current_balance=197.75), /api/cash/gym-londres/drawer (current_balance=117.4), /api/prazo/debts?store=runner (53 customers, R$8727.90), /api/prazo/debts?store=gym-londres (11 customers, R$1887.70), /api/expenses with basic-auth (122 items, R$23125.79). Frontend Prazo tab consolidated KPI shows R$10.615,60. No removeChild error observed during repeated filter switching. Reusable test file: /app/backend/tests/test_data_sync_verification_jan2026.py
rca of the issue: Original removeChild error (per problem statement) was hypothesized to be caused by partial_paid field migration leaving stale order references in the PrazoTab render tree. After the data fix migrating prazo_partial_paid -> partial_paid on 517 orders, plus the cash_drawer synthetic-flag filter and explicit balance field write, the Prazo tab now mounts/unmounts/refilters cleanly with zero DOM exceptions. No further fix required.
